correctness.rationale: The positivity/martingale proof is exact Gaussian conditional expectation; all-step moment bounds use a uniformly bounded cap and Jensen lower bound; the uniform local Taylor remainder is order h^{3/2} in L2, and the centered Itô--Taylor error obeys an L2 recursion yielding strong order one. Critical identities and numerical checks were replayed with embedded verify.py; finite tests supplement but do not replace proof.

value.rationale: The nonlinear driftless diffusion is a positive true martingale. The leading literature method combines positivity and strong-order-one only at small steps while the Gaussian quadratic tail may make numerical moments infinite on coarse steps. A single cap-plus-normalization simultaneously restores all-step moment finiteness and exact conditional mean, and the derived centered Milstein local error proves that these repairs preserve strong order one. This is a motivated constructive remedy with a full convergence theorem, not a reassertion of the known blowup threshold.
